pr_body:
**Description:**
after swc_ecma_loader find the module path, call canonicalize to make it resolve the symbolic links.

**Related issue (if exists):**
- Closes #2945
pr_comments: I'm really sorry, but can you change the config to opt-out instead? (`preserve_symlink`, as node.js already respects it.)

issue_context.title: spack: error when resolving packages with pnpm
comments: This closed issue has been automatically locked because it had no new activity for a month. If you are running into a similar issue, please create a new issue with the steps to reproduce. Thank you.

review_comments: Isn't it better to canonicalize here?
(Assuming the entry is not an symlink)
If we canonicalize at here, `base` on next resolving would use the canonicalized path, and it will reduce duplicated call to `base.canonicalize`.
